title: I Wish I'd Studied Art. Or Do I?

pre.en: Why is Ruth glad she studied law after all?
pre.zh: Ruth 为什么说当初学法律也不算白学？
options: It helped her read the lease on her studio properly.
Her father was proud of her.
She met her husband at work.

intro: 陶艺课上，趁着泥晾干，老师 Ruth 给学员们讲自己的经历：十八岁没敢学艺术、当了十五年律师、四十五岁才转行。读的时候留意 wish + 过去完成时：后悔已经发生、改不了的事，就说 I wish I'd done / I hadn't done。她不说教，结尾还有个小转折。

sentences.en: Right, while the clay dries, let me answer your favourite question: how did I end up here?
sentences.zh: 好，趁着泥晾干，我来回答一下你们最爱问的那个问题：我是怎么走到这一步的？

sentences.en: So, when I was eighteen, I wanted to study art.
sentences.zh: 是这样，十八岁那年，我想学艺术。

sentences.en: I used to draw on everything, and I've hung on to a folder of those drawings for forty-two years.
sentences.zh: 那时候我见什么画什么，那一夹子画，我留了整整四十二年。

sentences.en: But my father was a solicitor, and his father had been one too, so I followed in their footsteps and did law.
sentences.zh: 可我父亲是律师，祖父也是，于是我就走了他们的老路，学了法律。

sentences.en: At the time, it seemed like the sensible choice.
sentences.zh: 在当时，这看起来是最稳妥的选择。

sentences.en: I worked as a solicitor for fifteen years.
sentences.zh: 我当了十五年律师。

sentences.en: Most of my clients wanted to make a complaint about a neighbour's tree or wall.
sentences.zh: 我的客户大多是来投诉邻居家的树或者墙的。

sentences.en: I didn't hate the job, but I had doubts about it every Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 我并不讨厌这份工作，可一到星期一早上，我就怀疑自己是不是选错了。

sentences.en: I couldn't stand the long meetings, and the excitement of every new case wore off by Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 我受不了那些没完没了的会，每接一个新案子，那股新鲜劲儿到星期三就没了。

sentences.en: For years I went back and forth: art or law, art or law.
sentences.zh: 好多年里我都在来回纠结：艺术还是法律，艺术还是法律。

sentences.en: Then I had kids and took a few years off.
sentences.zh: 后来有了孩子，我在家歇了几年。

sentences.en: At forty-five, I finally made a career change.
sentences.zh: 四十五岁那年，我终于转了行。

sentences.en: I took a pottery evening class, and two years later I opened this place.
sentences.zh: 我报了一个陶艺夜校班，两年后开了这间工作室。

sentences.en: This arch dates back to 1870, and the rent was a bargain.
sentences.zh: 这间桥洞工作室是 1870 年建的，房租便宜得很。

sentences.en: Nobody else wanted it, because — as you know — the room shakes whenever a train goes past.
sentences.zh: 别人都不要，因为——你们也知道——每过一趟火车，屋子都在晃。

sentences.en: I wish I could say the change was easy.
sentences.zh: 我也想说转行很顺利。

sentences.en: But in my first year, I earned less than my old monthly salary.
sentences.zh: 可第一年我挣的钱，还不如以前一个月的工资。

sentences.en: There are still days when I wish I'd been braver at eighteen.
sentences.zh: 直到现在，有时我还是会想：十八岁那年要是再勇敢一点就好了。

sentences.en: Sometimes I wish I'd shown my father those drawings.
sentences.zh: 有时我会想，当初要是把那些画拿给父亲看看就好了。

sentences.en: And I wish I hadn't spent all those years dreaming of making things instead of making them.
sentences.zh: 我还后悔，这么多年光想着做东西，却一直没动手去做。

sentences.en: So now I try to make every minute at the wheel count.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，我坐在拉坯机前的每一分钟都不想浪费。

sentences.en: And yes, some of you have asked if you should quit too.
sentences.zh: 对了，你们有几个人问过我，是不是也该辞职。

sentences.en: Maybe — but finish your bowls first.
sentences.zh: 也许吧——不过先把碗做完再说。

sentences.en: People often ask if I wish I'd never done law.
sentences.zh: 常有人问我，是不是后悔当初学了法律。

sentences.en: Not really.
sentences.zh: 倒也不是。

sentences.en: It's the only reason I read the lease on this place properly.
sentences.zh: 要不是学过法律，我也不会把这里的租约读得那么仔细。

cards.note: to keep something and not give it away or throw it away
cards.tip: hang 表示「挂」时过去式是 hung；英式也说 hold on to sth。
cards.example: I'd hang on to that receipt in case you need to take it back.

cards.note: 电脑里的文件夹也叫 folder。
英国律师分两种：solicitor 多做咨询、文书，barrister 出庭辩护；美式统称 lawyer。
to do the same job or the same things as someone, often a parent, did before you
cards.tip: sb's 跟着人称变：follow in my father's footsteps / in their footsteps；footsteps 一定用复数。
cards.example: Her mum is a doctor, and she wants to follow in her footsteps.

cards.note: at a particular moment in the past, especially when things seemed different from how they seem now
cards.tip: 常暗示「现在看法变了」；别和 at a time（一次、每次）混：one at a time。
cards.example: At the time I thought it was a good idea, but now I'm not so sure.

cards.note: 别和 sensitive（敏感的）混。
律师、设计师的客户用 client；商店的顾客用 customer。
to tell a company or person officially that you are not happy about something
cards.tip: 投诉什么用 about，向谁投诉用 to；动词是 complain about。
cards.example: I made a complaint to the council about the noise.

cards.note: to feel not sure whether something is right or true
cards.tip: doubts 常用复数；程度可以加 serious：have serious doubts about sth。
cards.example: I'm starting to have doubts about this plan.

cards.note: to dislike someone or something very much
to gradually stop having an effect
to keep changing your opinion or decision
cards.tip: 也有字面意思「来回走」；纠结的内容用 on / about：go back and forth on the decision。
cards.example: We went back and forth for weeks before we chose a name for the baby.

cards.note: to leave one kind of work and start doing a completely different kind
cards.tip: 从什么转到什么用 from … to …；career 是长期的职业道路，不是某一份工作（job）。
cards.example: At thirty-eight, he made a career change from banking to teaching.

cards.note: 英国很多老铁路桥下的拱洞被改成了酒吧、车行、工作室，火车一过，屋里就晃。
to have existed since a particular time in the past
to be sold for less than its real value
白领按月或按年拿的固定工资；按小时、按周拿的叫 wages。
to think a lot about something you would like to do
cards.tip: of 后面接 doing 或名词，不接 to do；英式过去式也常写 dreamt。
cards.example: When I was a kid, I dreamed of becoming a pilot.

cards.note: to use all the time you have in a useful or enjoyable way
cards.tip: count 在这里是「有价值、算数」；也说 make every second / day count。
cards.example: We only have two days in Rome, so let's make every minute count.

cards.note: 租约是 the lease on 某处房子；签租约 sign a lease。
